resources.string: Open a link on the TV
Sends a link to the TV as an app link, the way the remote opens apps, then says what the TV showed afterwards. Use it to see which links an app follows.
Sent. Watching the TV for %1$d seconds…
Not sent: a link needs a scheme such as https:// and no spaces.
Not sent: the remote link to the TV isn\'t ready.
Sent. The TV doesn\'t report what it shows right now, so check the screen.
Sent. %1$s stayed in front. tutti can\'t see inside the app, so check the screen to see whether it moved.
Sent. The TV now reports no app in front (before: %1$s).
